The One Hit Kit's Drum Essentials samples are encrypted; Core Library one-shots stand in, matched by family and length only (the Phase 4 kit survey). Each layer's gainDb is the set's Simpler volume plus part volume, plus the stand-in's peak normalisation to 0 dBFS: the originals' peaks are unknown, and pack one-shots are normalised.
Velocity: law 'simpler' with each Simpler's Vel. drive: the Simpler filter's drive in dB (the filters are open at 22 kHz); Live applies it before the Simpler volume, to the sample at its own level.

Not reproduced: the reverbs on pads 38 and 39 and the Limiter on 38 (heard only when the onset note is 38 or 39), and the kit's 'Drum Machines Audio Effect' chain, which MegaSA builds as the onset FX (\megaSAOnsetFx).
